access_ledger_note: The checksum sweep touched all 626 files for integrity only. This ledger records inspected/retrieved source ranges, CSV reads and targeted snippets separately; it does not claim every line of every packet file was reviewed. Large retrievals may have displayed bounded excerpts; claims rely on relevant inspected ranges and corroborating sources.
external_fact_policy: No external historical, scientific, political or economic facts were needed to decide chart capability. Prepared data are evidence of the supplied examples, not independent verification of their historical claims.

checks_actually_run.description: Extracted packet and checked all 626 supplied manifest paths, byte sizes and SHA-256 values; repeated at finalization.

Independent Node built-in stripTypeScriptTypes plus isolated evaluation of local dashboard constants. 48 dashboard exports, 29 composition dashboards/charts; all match inventory/registry/coverage, no extra tabs in these entries. Not application execution or a product test.
Reviewed all 29 complete definitions and relevant composition/built-in settings, preparations, renderers, interactions, annotations, facets, validation, save/text and intended tests; ledger above.

Searched demo saved tabs, live documentation aliases and related definitions for additional delivered compositions. Searched library source for Copy PNG/image/png/artboardPng; matches were composition output/inspector only.
Python CSV parsing, row/key uniqueness, date multiplicity, null/absent distinctions, exact count/share/endpoint and baseline checks; recorded below. No product or data-preparation tests executed.

checks: Each of the 29 inventory IDs appears exactly once in verdict JSON, detailed Markdown headings, and the 29-row verdict table.
Required verdict fields, five allowed categories, and yes/no/conditional answers with reasons are present; counts reconcile to 29.
Stable REC-01 through REC-26 IDs, affected-example IDs, verdict references and required dependency IDs are valid; no internal candidate IDs remain.
Every small-extension has concrete gaps, linked code seams, interaction cost and a Try/Observe/Decide proof.

All citations to existing source paths and line ranges in structured verdicts/recommendation seams exist in the supplied manifest; proposed new file locations are explicitly labeled and are not treated as delivered source.
All 626 packet files still match their supplied size and SHA-256; no repository source changed.
All four JSON companions parse, all five text artifacts decode as UTF-8, and the report has no unresolved assembly markers.
ZIP has exactly the five required root-level members; every member is byte-identical to its companion file; CRC/integrity check passes.
Manifest counts, companion/archive sizes and available SHA-256 values match actual artifacts. Manifest self-hash and archive hash are deliberately omitted to avoid recursive hashes.
